reason.wcd_formula_used: WCD_f_i = offset_i + (n + 1) * cycle_duration + n * switching_delay + propagation_delay + time_sync_error
reason.wcd_formula_explanation: For CQF with cut-through switches: offset at source (0 µs) + (number_of_switches + 1) * cycle_duration + number_of_switches * switching_delay + total_propagation_delay (1 µs) + time_synchronization_error (1 µs). The term (n+1)*cycle_duration accounts for the worst-case queuing delay across n switches plus the initial cycle at the source. The term n*switching_delay accounts for the processing delay at each switch. Propagation delay and time sync error are added once per flow end-to-end.
